target: Add a loopback planner service and allowlisted GitHub GET/HEAD evidence refresh with ETag caching, freshness, degraded-state retention, and zero external write capability.
invariants: Risk lane is L3 because network, credentials, and external evidence freshness are introduced.
Both AdOps and dNh extension packets must be accepted before activation.
GitHub transport permits only GET and HEAD to api.github.com for configured repositories and resources.
The service binds loopback port 3030, selected as unused in services/registry.yaml at design time; dispatch must stop if inventory has changed.
Tokens never enter logs, errors, models, fixtures, proof, cache payloads, or API responses.
Refresh mutates only an ephemeral planner cache and never external state.

execution.stacked_because: Consumes accepted source adapters and introduces the separate live-read boundary.

commit.message: feat(planner): add read-only GitHub evidence refresh

pr.title: feat(planner): add allowlisted GitHub evidence refresh
pr.body: L3 read-only GitHub collector and loopback cache service for the accepted planner contracts. GET/HEAD only, ETag-aware, fail-closed, credential-safe, and externally non-mutating. One final independent security/authority audit required.

steps.task: Define a closed GitHub transport and source configuration contract.
requirements: Define GitHubReadTransport.request(method: Literal[GET, HEAD], url: str, headers: Mapping[str, str]) -> ReadResponse.
Allow only DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp, DDD-Enterprises/adOps, and DDD-Enterprises/dnh-crm plus explicit refs, paths, PRs, commits, checks, reviews, and review threads.
Reject unknown methods, hosts, redirects, repository aliases, ref injection, path traversal, archive URLs, and submodule escapes before transport.
Write failing tests for every forbidden method and locator.
validation: POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE, GraphQL mutation, and unknown methods are structurally impossible or rejected before I/O.
Sanitized exceptions contain no authorization header or token substring.

steps.task: Implement ETag-aware evidence collection and stale/degraded cache semantics using mock transport first.
requirements: Collect repository head, configured blobs, PR metadata, changed files, commits, checks, reviews, review threads, and issue comments required by the readiness contract.
Support If-None-Match and 304 without rewriting unchanged canonical payload bytes.
Use bounded concurrency, connection and total timeouts, rate-limit backoff without automatic retry storms, and one retained last-known-good snapshot per source.
One source failure must mark that source stale/degraded without erasing other projects.
validation: Mock transport observes only allowlisted GET/HEAD requests.
Tests cover 200, 304, 401, 403, 404, 429, timeout, redirect, malformed JSON, and partial-source failure.
Repeated 304 refresh retains byte-identical portfolio content.

steps.task: Expose the loopback-only planner API and register port 3030 after collision preflight.
requirements: Stop if current services/registry.yaml or socket inspection shows port 3030 occupied; amend the packet before selecting another port.
Expose GET /health, GET /v1/portfolio, GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/lanes/{lane_id}, and POST /v1/refresh.
POST /v1/refresh may mutate cache only; it cannot accept arbitrary URLs, repositories, refs, methods, or credentials.
Bind 127.0.0.1 by default and require explicit configuration for any wider bind.
Feature flag defaults off; fixture mode remains available.
validation: Route census contains no repository, GitHub, Task Orchestrator, acceptance, or merge write endpoint.
Non-loopback default bind test fails closed.
Refresh input cannot widen configured source scope.

steps.task: Wire live freshness and manual cache refresh into the existing planner UI.
requirements: Show last success, source age, current/stale/degraded status, sanitized errors, and refresh progress.
Refresh control must say cache refresh and cannot imply source mutation.
Preserve fixture mode and all provenance/conflict views.
validation: UI clearly distinguishes cached observation time from source event time.
Errors expose no credentials or raw provider response bodies.

steps.task: Freeze the content head and complete one independent L3 security and authority audit.
requirements: Audit method closure, URL validation, redirect behavior, token handling, cache-only mutation, loopback binding, fail-closed readiness, and source-repository inertness.
A live smoke test is NOT_RUN unless the operator separately authorizes credentials and exact GET/HEAD scope.
Any audit mismatch or non-passing verdict blocks readiness.
validation: Proof binds the exact audited head and records live smoke as PASS or NOT_RUN without bluffing.
PR remains unmerged pending Control Tower disposition.
